references.text: Moses gave the tribe of Gad, the tribe of Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh the land east of the Jordan as their inheritance.
The tribe of Reuben and the tribe of Gad and half the tribe of Manasseh had already received their inheritance on the east side of the Jordan.
The Levites were given no earthly inheritance among the people of Israel, because the Lord himself is their inheritance.
The tribe of Levi received no share of the inheritance with their brothers, because the Lord is their inheritance.
Levitical priests and the entire tribe of Levi were to have no share of the inheritance with Israel, because the Lord is their inheritance.
Only the tribe of Levi Moses gave no inheritance, because the fire of the Lord's offerings was their inheritance.
The tribe of Levi Moses gave no inheritance, for the Lord, the God of Israel, is their inheritance.
The Levites have no share among you, for the priesthood of the Lord is their inheritance.
